tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi sngon gyi skyes rabs rnams sa skya pa'i 'phrin las kyi mgon po pu tra dmar pos lung bstan du stsal pa'i gsung shog rim pa gnyis gsal byed kyi yig chung mkhan tshangs pas phul ba dang bcas pa'i yi ge bzhugs// oṃ swa sti siddhiṃ/ bstan srung kun gyi gtso bo rdo rje nag po chen po'i thugs kyi sprul pa bka' bsdod yongs kyi gtso bo dam can mon bu pu tra'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rnam rol sa skya pa'i 'phrin las kyi mgon po tse'u dmar po zhes yongs su grags shing / sngon slob dpon chen pos dbang bskur mdzad dus kyi gsang mtshan kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal du gsol ba'i dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs pa ye shes kyi mgon po pu tra dmar po de nyid kyis/ dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi sngon gyi skyes rabs rnams lung bstan bka' stsal pa rim pa gnyis kyi snga ma las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ ༈ /sa dkar po'i yul na rig 'dzin rgyud pa spel ba'i rig 'dzin pho brang dam pa der/ rgya nag po'i yul gyi rtse lnga nas/ /smra ba'i seng ge ming du btags/ /'ja' tshugs su ldan pa'i rta pho de la zhon/ /gu ru padma'i dus zhi ba 'tsho dang bstun/ /mkhas pa shrī singha'i ming du btags/ /bkod pa yar la gcig byas na/ /ston pa shākya'i dus mau 'gal gyi bu/ /rim par brgyud pa'i gnam khri srong btsan/ /de la gces pa mgar ba'i ming / /nye bar brgyud pa'i chos ni dar ba'i dus/ /sgra sgyur rnams kyi gral la 'khod/ /bar ma do yi 'ga' shas su/ /rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du sprul pa byung / /rgya gar yul nas tshur la log bod yul sa dkar kun dga'i ming can de la zlo ba/ zhes 'byung ba yin la/ de dag gi don chos skyong chen pos mkhan tshangs par lhug stsol du phebs 'dug pa dang mthun par cung zad tsam tshigs su bcad pa'i sgo nas bkral na 'di lta ste/

༈ /rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga'i pho brang nas/ /sangs rgyas gsung gi gsang ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /smra ba'i seng ge gang de don dam par/ /zab mo chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /sems can don du kun rdzob gdul bya'i ngor/ /ston mchog dam pa shākya'i rgyal po nyid/ /rigs can gsum la chos 'khor skor ba'i dus/ /nyan thos rdzu 'phrul can gyi mchog gyur pa/ /mau 'gal gyi bu zhes bya bar sprul/ /'di yi rnam thar mdo sde rnams las 'byung / /slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas dang / /mkhas pa chen po zhi ba 'tsho yi dus/ /u rgyan nyid dang bai ro tsa na sogs/ /mkhas grub kun la man ngag stsol mdzad pa'i/ /paṇa chen shrī singha zhes byar sprul/ /'di yi rnam thar thang yig 'ga' las 'byung / /bod yul chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus/ /rgya bal rten gsum rin chen chos 'khor lha sa'i jo shag rnam gnyis sogs/ spyan drangs sogs/ /bod yul bde skyid 'byung ba'i byed po mchog /blon po mgar ba stong btsan zhes byar sprul/ /de yi mdzad pa rgyal rab rnams las gsal/ /de nas bod 'dir bstan pa dar ba'i tshe/ /sgra sgyur lo tsā rtsod bral du mar sprul/ /de nas ha cang mi ring bar gyi char/ /rgya gar yul gyi skyes chen du ma ru/ /sprul nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i don mang mdzad/ /slar yang bod yul mun pa'i smag rum 'dir/ /sngags 'chang chos rjes bstan pa'i me ro nyid/ /legs par gsos pa 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phyir/ /bod yul rdo rje gdan gyi chos grwa 'dir/ /lha rigs 'khon gyi gdung 'dzin sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun bsod grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang po'i mtshan can nyid du legs sprul pa/ /yin zhes dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa yi/ /'phrin las mgon pos rab tu bsngags pa 'di/ /kun las khyad par 'phags pa'i rnam thar yin/ /des na shākya'i dus na mau 'gal bu/ /padma'i dus na shrī singha'i mtshan/

/srong btsan sgam po'i dus na blon po mgar/ /da lta ngag dbang kun dga'i mtshan can yin/ /thos bsam sgom pas lung rtogs yon tan brnyes/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pas bstan pa zla ltar spel/ /'dzin skyong spel bas thub pa'i rgyal sa 'dzin/ /mgon 'di'i mdzad pa byis blo'i yul las 'das/ /zhes bya bas rtogs te khong du chud par bya'o// ༈ //yang 'phrin las kyi mgon po de nyid kyis sngags 'chang bla ma'i skyes rabs kyi lung bstan rim pa gnyis pa las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ dam tshig dang ldan pa sa dkar po'i yul gyi dge bshes kun dga'i ming can de la zlo ba/ gdug 'drer rgya dar sa gzhi'i me tog ri mo bcas byung pa dga' rab yin/ gdug 'dres sngon chad gyi dus su dge bshes kyi skyes rabs rnams rdo rje gdan gyi paṇḍi ta nas nye bar bzung ba'i ri mor bkod pa yin kyang / the tshom gyi bkod pa byung 'dug pa/ gdug 'dre'i lus khog 'di'i thog tu ri mor bkod pa/ paṇḍi tar khas 'che ba shrī singha zhes bya bar lung bstan cing / de la the tshom gyi bkod pa byung na rnying ma'i chos skor rnams la ltos/ khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus su lo tsā ba klu'i rgyal mtshan/ da lta'i dus su kun dga'i ming can 'di/ /bstan pa rgyas shing chos 'khor 'phel bar yong / /gsol ba thob cig skye 'gro'i sems can rnams/ /shis par gyur cig phyi dus klu'i ming can du skye ba blangs pa dge bshes rang gi blo la gsal/ zhes lha tshes nyer drug la dpe har lha'i pho brang sde brgyad rba klong 'khrugs pa'i gzhal yas khang nas bris/ zhes 'byung ba yin/ chos skyong chen po'i lung bstan phyi ma 'di nyid kyi gsal byed kyi yi ge mkhan tshangs pas phul ba las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ ༈ /thung pa 'bul 'bras/ zhabs drung rin po che'i 'khrungs rabs/ dge bshes la dogs pa byung ba e yin/ dge bshes kyi skye brgyud rags rim snga sor gdug 'dres ri mor bkod pa de yin/

sngon chad gdug 'dres ri mor bkod pa bzhin/ shrī singha ni rdo rje gdan gyi rgya bkrol mkhan gyi paṇḍi ta de yin/ khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus su lo tsā ba lcog ro klu'i rgya mtshan yin/ dge bshes rang gi brgyud du ni/ phar 'gro tshur 'gro yar log mar log byas pa yin/ de ni dge bshes rang la rmi lam sgyu ma'i tshul du sram tsam sram tsam yod pa yin pas/ gdug 'dre la 'dri mi dgos/ gdug 'dres thog ma'i sgo 'byed byas pa de yin/ phyis kyi mkhas pa chen po mang thos klu sgrub sogs kyang dge bshes rang la gsal ba de yin/ paṇḍi ta sgo mtha' yas pa dang / kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge sogs yin pa dge bshes rang zer ma bde ba ma gtogs/ gdug 'dre las dge bshes rang gsal/ blo la gang shar ri mor 'khod chog pa yod phebs byung ba/ zhabs drung rin po che sku nyid kyi rnam thar rgyas pa zhig 'byung ba'i rgyur 'gro ba zhig cis kyang mkhyen mkhyen lags/ zhes pa de dag ni dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi sngon gyi skyes rabs rnams chos skyong chen pos lung bstan du stsal pa rim pa gnyis gsal byed kyi yi ge dang bcas pa rnams/ bstan 'dzin gyi bu slob dad pa can rnams la phan pa'i phyir phyogs gcig tu 'bri dgos zhes nan gyis bskul ba po dag gi ngor/ rnal 'byor pa gdod nas rang grol gyis bgyis pa 'dis 'phral dang yun du dge legs su gyur cig/ ༈ //sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang gi gnas lugs sgro btags kyi sgo nas brjod pa gong ma'i byin rlabs myur 'jug ces bya ba bzhugs/ /bkra shis rgyal bar gyur cig bod yul chen po'i rtse lnga'i ri bo'i spor/ /rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i rang gzugs lhag pa'i lha/ /de nyid gdul bya gang la gang 'dul gyi/ /sprul pas zlos gar bsgyur der gsol ba 'debs/ /de yang ston mchog shākya'i rgyal po yi/

/nyan thos mchog zung ya gyal mau 'gal bu/ /paṇa grub dbang po shrī singha zhes/ /yongs grags skyes bu'i mchog der gsol ba 'debs/ /de dang gcig min gnyis su ma mchis pa'i/ /rig gnas kun mkhyen chos tshul zab mo'i gter/ /mi thub zla ba nas bzung paṇḍi ta'i/ /skye ba bcu gcig bzhes la gsol ba 'debs/ /gzhan yang 'phags yul mkhas dang grub pa'i phul/ /rab tu byung dang gsang sngags 'chang ba'i tshul/ /paṇa chen sgo mtha' yas pa'i blo gros sogs/ /bdun phrag rim par byon la gsol ba 'debs/ /de nas bod yul mun sel lo tsā ba/ /lcog ro klu rgyal gyi jo zla 'od sogs/ /skad gnyis smra ba gangs can 'gro ba'i mig /sgra sgyur du mar 'khrungs la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyad par byang phyogs thub pa'i rgyal tshab che/ /lha babs 'khon rigs sa skya'i gdung 'dzin mchog /dpal ldan rtse mo zhabs dang grags pa'i mtshan/ rje btsun 'di dang bai ro tsa na/ chos rje sa paṇa/ bde gshegs dri ma med dpal/ sngags 'chang chen po rnams thugs rgyud gcig par rnam thar las gsal/ /skyes chen mched du sprul la gsol ba 'debs/ /phyis dus dam pa'i rigs 'khrungs chos srid kyi/ /dpal la dbang bsgyur theg chen chos rje dang / /kun mkhyen mkhas pa'i dbang po go ram pa/ /bsod nams seng ger 'khrungs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gzhan yang mkhas grub dbang po gong dkar ba/ /rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal dang / rje 'di dang shrī singha/ zhi ba 'tsho/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ klong chen rab 'byams pa rnams thugs rgyud gcig par bshad/ /mang du thos pa 'dzam gling mkhas pa'i rgyan/ /klu sgrub rgya mtshor rje 'di dang 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho gnyis thugs rgyud gcig par yang mi 'gal lam snyam/ 'khrungs la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge nyid/ /gzhan ngor sprul pa du ma'i snang brnyan rnams/ /gcig bsdus deng sang bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog

/sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen par gsol ba 'debs/ /tshul 'di 'phrin las mgon po'i lung bstan dang / /skyes chen gong ma'i rnam thar rjes dpags nas/ /blo gsal dpyod ldan rnams kyis yang yang du/ /yid ches nges pa rnyed der gsol ba 'debs/ /'gro kun sems nyid lhan skyes ye shes dang / /rgyal kun thugs kyi lhan skyes ye shes gnyis/ /gnas lugs lhan skyes ye shes ro gcig phyir/ /'khor 'das lhan skyes ye shes ngo bor snyam/ /de ltar tshul la bsam nas dad ldan gyi/ /slob bu rnams kyis mkhas grub du ma'i sku/ /gsar du bskrun pa bsod nams rgya chen po/ /thob phyir de skad smra la skyon yod min/ /de ltar bsam nas skyes chen bzang rim par/ /byon pa'i rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /su zhig gsol ba 'debs pa de dag gi /'di phyi'i don kun yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig /mtshungs med sa skya'i rje btsun thams cad mkhyen/ /sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga'i mtshan can gyis/ /rnam thar bsam bzhin gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /yongs 'dzin bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog /tshul 'di rang bzhin brjod pa nyid/ /min mod sgo btags gtsor byas shing / /rang babs gnas lugs la bsam na/ /brjod la'ang nyes pa med 'dra snyam/ /dam pa'i rigs su skyes mod kyang / /lung rtogs yon tan dang bral ba'i/ /yar 'dren gzugs brnyan a nandas/ /bris so dad ldan kun dgyes shog/ //shu bhaṃ// ༈ //gter ston kong po bla mas phul ba'i rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po'i gter byon thugs rje chen po ngan song rang grol las/ sna nam skye ba sa skya'i mthil du 'byung / /mtha' dmag bzlog pa'i rten 'brel de la yod/ /bar chad bzlog pa'i rim gro zur du gsal/ /zhes dang / yang dpal mgon ma ning gi lung bstan rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po'i gter byon gcig tu/ gzhan yang zab gter 'di yi bka' bab ni/ /gnam sa chos 'byung 'dra ba'i sa phyogs su/

/sa yi ming can gsang sngags chos la mos/ /khyad par padma bdag la gus pa'i mi/ /bya yi lo pa thugs kar sme nag ldan/ /'brel tshad don ldan de la gtad rgya gyis/ /zhes gsungs lags// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ 'jam mgon a myes zhabs kyi sngon gyi skyes rabs gsal byed dang bcas pa'i yi ge/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
